title: azurerm_latest_tag asks the registry once per process, failure included
goal: azurerm_latest_tag asks the Terraform registry once per process whether it answers with a tag or fails (a non-200 status, a body that is no JSON, a tag of the wrong shape), so a failing registry is not asked again on every raw_url call; it still returns the empty string after a failure.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import provider; n=[]; provider.request=lambda u,*a,**k: (n.append(u), {'status':500,'body':b''})[1]; [provider.azurerm_latest_tag() for _ in range(3)]; assert len(n)==1, len(n)
